name: Tire Company Debica S.A.
summary: Tire Company Debica S.A. manufactures and sells tires for passenger cars, vans, and trucks in Poland. It also offers vulcanizing membranes to produce tires and compounds rubber. The company exports tires to Luxembourg, Germany, Turkey, the United States, Canada, and France. It serves under the Debica, Goodyear, Dunlop, Fulda, and Sava brands. The company was formerly known as Firma Oponiarska Debica S.A. Tire Company Debica S.A. was founded in 1937 and is based in Debica, Poland. Tire Company Debica S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Goodyear S.A.
